messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need some help with my upcoming flight. I thought I added insurance to my booking, but when I check online, it’s not showing up. My family members all have insurance on their tickets, so I really want to make sure I have it too. Can you help me sort this out?

I can help you with that. To assist you better, could you please provide me with your user ID and the reservation ID for your upcoming flight? This will allow me to check the insurance status on your booking.
Sure, my user ID is sophia_taylor_9065 and the reservation number is PEP4E0. Please check and let me know what’s going on—I really need to have insurance added like the rest of my family.

Your reservation currently does not have travel insurance added. Since your booking is in basic economy class, travel insurance can only be added at the time of booking and cannot be added afterward.

If you want, I can help you explore other options or assist with any other requests related to your flight. How would you like to proceed?

I really need to have insurance on my flight, just like my family members. There must be something you can do—everyone else in my group has it, and I thought I added it when I booked. Is there any way you can make an exception or help me get insurance added to my reservation? I don’t want to travel without it.

I understand your concern about having travel insurance. However, according to the airline policy, travel insurance cannot be added to a reservation after the initial booking. This rule applies to all passengers and reservations without exceptions.

If you want, I can assist you with other options such as checking if there are any available flights for rebooking with insurance included or help with any other requests you may have. Please let me know how you would like to proceed.

I really don’t want to rebook my flight or make any changes to my plans—I just want to have insurance like everyone else in my family. Isn’t there any way you can help me add it to my current reservation? I’m really worried about traveling without insurance, and I’d appreciate anything you can do to help.

I understand your worry, but I must adhere to the airline policy, which does not allow adding travel insurance to an existing reservation after booking. Unfortunately, I cannot make exceptions to this rule.

If you have any other concerns or need assistance with something else regarding your flight, please let me know. I'm here to help within the scope of the policy.

I understand you have policies, but this is really important to me. Is there anyone you can talk to or anything you can do on your end to help me get insurance added? I really don’t want to be the only one in my family without it. Please, I’d really appreciate your help with this.
